scope: Remove temporary collected Vec from ta.linreg and ta.swma; pure host-neutral runtime semantics.

productionChange.swma: Four stack samples; original expression and operation grouping unchanged.
productionChange.linreg: Length one returns the original sample; otherwise scan the existing queue in logical order using flatten/copied/enumerate/for_each, preserving the four sequential accumulators and all later formulas.
productionChange.complexity: General LinReg remains O(length). Ordinary per-invocation append, dynamic length, NA, call-site identity, public IDs and output contracts unchanged.

qualifiedSource.scopeLimit: Byte-checks exact frozen source and unchanged guards; detailed production-diff semantic review is separate.

newTestScope: Independent ordinary VecDeque plus legacy collected-Vec formulas, Float bits and NA masks; page boundaries, actual ready dynamic shrink/expand, invalid lengths, named/NA/large offsets, signed zero/subnormal/extreme/overflow inputs, loops, prepared realtime/deltas/Replica/no-output/confirm/correction/replay, requested data and separate chart state.

measurement.processOrder: repeat, then case, then alternating before/after by repeat
measurement.aggregation: Median of nine forming calls per process, then median of three fresh processes; other stages one measured call per process.
measurement.scope: Public native API; analyze, PreparedProgram construction, historical append+owned result, stream seed without output, forming without output, borrowed forming delta. Session construction, caller drops, full serialization, independent old-Vec oracle, profile reads, replica setup/apply, changed confirmation/future checks and receipt I/O outside measured windows.
measurement.allocator: Successful System Layout requested bytes/counts, including realloc requests; peak additional live requested bytes above stage entry and signed exit live delta. Cumulative allocatedBytes is not concurrent memory usage. Excludes allocator overhead/residency and transient realloc double buffers; not RSS.

compileOverlap.limit: Formal process timestamps and root observed tool-completion UTC receipts show sampling began after completed gates/build/link; root observation is a conservative completion upper bound, not a fabricated process-end timestamp or OS trace.

allocationControlAudit.accounting: Successful System requested Layout bytes/counts; realloc removes old live size and adds new size once, peak additional requested live above entry, signed exit live delta. Excludes allocator overhead/residency and transient realloc double buffers; not RSS.
allocationControlAudit.timingLimit: All raw ms samples, fresh-process medians/ranges and slower observations retained. Instrumented allocation reductions do not prove general interpreter CPU throughput.

baselinePreflight.scope: Separate baseline qualification, excluded from all before/after performance summaries.

supplemental.reason: Original SWMA medians were slower despite removing temporary allocations; preserve all original observations and compare fixed SWMA/variance/zero controls in a separate three-repeat batch.
supplemental.summaryAggregation: Per-process median of nine forming samples, then median of three fresh processes. Original 48-process data remains separate and unchanged; no faster-batch selection or attribution of timing changes to noise.

interpretation: Long-window LinReg allocation and instrumented latency gains are bounded to this native fixture. SWMA reliably removes one 32-byte temporary request per ready invocation, but both batches contain slower timing observations. No general SWMA or interpreter CPU-throughput gain is established; unchanged controls also vary. All slow observations are retained without selecting a faster batch.

deferred.pageDirectoryCopy: Arc<VecDeque<Arc<Page<T>>>> directory is still copied on shared endpoint writes. For an ordinary append without a page-boundary transition, with a partially filled tail and both directory and tail shared, read-only source audit estimates directory allocation 48+8*N bytes plus bounded page 40+2048 bytes on 64-bit Option<f64>, four successful requests total. The examples use 2/24/782 pages; page counts also depend on front_offset and endpoints, and a full-tail insertion can require directory growth. These are structure-derived examples, not allocator measurements or a universal per-length cost.
deferred.possibleDirection: Separate endpoints from a shared directory of full middle pages; requires measuring clone/small-window cost and proving page boundaries, dynamic shrink/grow, history and retained-capacity invariants.
deferred.other: General LinReg/WMA/HMA/variance scans, Map/Matrix secondary dispatch, and recursive HIR require further actual hotspot attribution.

failures: No new production test, gate, probe, or independent-audit failures occurred in this wave. The supplemental batch was triggered by slower SWMA observations, not by a failing threshold.
limitations: Offline native indicator fixtures and canonical correctness gates only; no TradingView numerical parity, process RSS, host/strategy/request throughput, full resource matrix, cross-platform throughput, or release qualification.
